content.short: Solidity Documentation Generator automatically exports Solidity project documentation to Markdown.
content.description: Solidity Documentation Generator is a package in the OpenZeppelin ecosystem that extracts high-level documentation from a Solidity codebase. Developers can use it to write more informative comments or to export entire volumes of Markdown documentation for Solidity projects. It is relied on by well over two thousand developers and technical writers, with a growing number of contributors. As an open-source tool, it invites ongoing collaboration from the community to improve Solidity project documentation.
